notes: Canonical intent labels shared by Branch A, Branch B, the dispatcher and the evaluation tools. Do not add per-course, per-place or per-person intents: course, weekday, location and contact are slots.

intents.label: help
intents.description: The student asks what Pepper can do.
intents.en_hypothesis: This is a request for help or for what the assistant can do.

intents.label: ask_time
intents.description: The student asks for the current time.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks what the current time is.

intents.label: ask_current_class
intents.description: The student asks which class or exam is on right now.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks which class or exam is happening right now.

intents.label: ask_next_class
intents.description: The student asks which class or exam is next.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks what the next class or exam is.

intents.label: ask_lecturer
intents.description: The student asks who lectures a course.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks who the lecturer of a course is.

intents.label: ask_course_time
intents.description: The student asks when a course meets or when its exam is.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks when a course or its exam takes place.

intents.label: ask_course_venue
intents.description: The student asks where a course or its exam is held.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks where a course or its exam is held.

intents.label: ask_day_schedule
intents.description: The student asks what is scheduled on a day (classes or exams; today if no day is given).
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks for the classes or exams on a day.

intents.label: list_courses
intents.description: The student asks which Honours courses there are.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks for the list of courses.

intents.label: ask_current_semester
intents.description: The student asks which part of the academic year it is (teaching block, break, exam period).
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks which semester, term or academic period it currently is.

intents.label: open_self_service
intents.description: The student asks to open Wits Student Self-Service.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks to open the student self-service portal.

intents.label: ask_contact
intents.description: The student asks whom to contact in the School, or for a contact's email or phone number.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks for a contact person, email address or phone number.

intents.label: ask_directions
intents.description: The student asks where a campus building or room is, or how to get there.
intents.en_hypothesis: This asks for directions to a place on campus.

intents.label: OOS
intents.description: Out of scope: anything the assistant does not support, including requests for help it cannot give (e.g. student fees).
intents.en_hypothesis: This is about something unrelated to classes, time or self-service.

slots.course: Course code from data/courses.json, e.g. COMS4054A. Filled from a spoken code or a course alias.
slots.weekday: monday ... sunday, or the relative values today / tomorrow. Resolved to the next matching date.
slots.location: A location id from data/locations.json, or a room such as MSL005.
slots.contact: A contact id from data/contacts.json, e.g. head_of_school.
slots.topic: An out-of-scope topic id from data/out_of_scope_topics.json (e.g. student_fees), used only by the OOS reply.
